The party fixtures place this spec on level 60 (1 member). [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/paladin/holy/talents.yaml`, `rotation.yaml`]

## How the bots play it

On every decision tick the loop walks the rules in ascending `priority`, executes the first one whose condition is true and skips the rest of that tick. The groups below are a reading aid; the priority numbers are the real order. Level is the rule's own `level_min` — the first level it can fire.

### Single target

- **83 — Judgement** (`PH14j-judgement-of-wisdom`) — level 60+ · intent `filler` · spell 20271
  - **When:** the target is hostile; the target is within 10 yd; Judgement is off cooldown; the resident has Seal of Wisdom; at least 65 mana; the lowest party health at least 45%; (the target does not have Judgement of Wisdom or the target's Judgement of Wisdom time left is less than 3 s).
  - **Why:** HO-TKB-PLAY-221: "Keep up: Seal of Wisdom, and Judgement of Wisdom on a long-lived target.
  - Sources: [holy.md § Holy Paladin (healer) (L3)](holy.md#holy-paladin-healer); [holy.md § How to play (L28)](holy.md#how-to-play); [holy.md § Single-target healing (priority list) (L142)](holy.md#single-target-healing-priority-list); [holy.md § Mana management (L185)](holy.md#mana-management); [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/paladin/holy/rotation.yaml`; supporting: `doc research/db-queries/tkbplay-221.result.txt`].

## Situational notes from the rule notes

Every sentence below is copied from a rule's own note (the rule id is in front of it) and mentions a situation the rule exists for. Rest, food and drink rules are left out here; their items are in the band table above.

- **PH00u-wizard-oil — Apply Brilliant Wizard Oil:** The spec's own guide page names it (line 250); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **PH00u-mageblood — Use Mageblood Potion:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Mageblood Potion (item 20007, required level 40), elixir or potion (aura 24363 while it lasts), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 252); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **PH00u-dreamshard — Use Dreamshard Elixir:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Dreamshard Elixir (item 61224, required level 46), elixir or potion (aura 45427 while it lasts), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 252); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **PH00u-fortitude — Use Elixir of Fortitude:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Elixir of Fortitude (item 3825, required level 25), elixir or potion (aura 3593 while it lasts), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 252); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **PH00u-demonic-rune — Use Demonic Rune:** HO-TKB-PLAY-206 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18; ruling: a rule naming an item nobody holds is free): Demonic Rune (item 12662).
- **PH00u-tea — Use Nordanaar Herbal Tea:** Restores 525 health and 810 mana (spell 19398, instant) and shares its 120 s category 1172 with the Dark and Demonic Runes; the guide names it as the mana cooldown beside the potions.
- **PH16-redemption — Redemption:** OQ-2765's check, and this file had the same shape as the priest's: PH16 sat at priority 160, below every buff, every defensive, both heals, both cleanses, the interrupt and both offensive rules - fifteenth of sixteen ability rules, above only the vendor and loot actions this class shares with every other spec. `Rotation::rules` is sorted ascending and stops at the first true rule, so a dead party member competed against Devotion Aura, Blessing of Wisdom, Seal of Wisdom, Lay on Hands, Divine Shield, Hand of Protection, Divine Protection, Holy Shock, Holy Light, Flash of Light, Cleanse, Purify, Hammer of Justice, Judgement and Holy Strike, every one of which outranked raising the tank.
- **PH01c-concentration-aura — Concentration Aura:** HO-TKB-PLAY-095 (orchestrator rank 4, round 106): the holy paladin in a PARTY keeps Concentration Aura (spell 19746, level 22): the guide table names it for pushback from mobs hitting the caster (paladin/leveling.md L174, L244: for self-healing with Spiritual Focus), and a healer is the member whose casts are pushed back. Devotion Aura waits while it is up.
- **PH01-devotion-aura — Devotion Aura:** Free, no duration, no stance gate; the aura a healer keeps because armour helps the whole party and nothing else competes for the slot. HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **PH02-blessing-of-wisdom — Blessing of Wisdom:** HO-TKB-PLAY-025 (vocabulary v8, HO-P1-LOOP-016): `target: party_missing`: the nearest member in range and sight (the resident first, at 0 yd) lacking this buff's aura chain, instead of the lowest-health member; the one-member limit described below is gone. The holy paladin's one blessing is Wisdom (holy.md L136), so no second blessing rule replaces it (one blessing per paladin per target, SpellEntry.h).
- **PH03-seal-of-wisdom — Seal of Wisdom:** The seal this spec keeps: 65 mana for 30 s, and its judgement returns mana to the party. Re-sealed only in combat, because a 30 s aura spent out of combat is wasted mana.
- **PH05-divine-shield — Divine Shield:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).
- **PH07-divine-protection — Divine Protection:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568, OQ-2569): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). Once the eat rule stops re-pushing into its own aura, nothing else holds a self-defensive, a form, an aura or a mana cooldown back while seated, and any cast stands the resident up (Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0).
- **PH14j-judgement-of-wisdom — Judgement:** HO-TKB-PLAY-221: "Keep up: Seal of Wisdom, and Judgement of Wisdom on a long-lived target. Spend a GCD on Judgement + re-seal after a fast Holy Light or when the debuff is about to drop", "Seal of Wisdom -> Judgement of Wisdom -> Seal of Wisdom, Holy Strike, Illumination ... plenty enough for Paladin to never run out of mana" (holy.md L3, L28, L142, L185).
- **PH11m-cleanse-must — Cleanse:** HO-TKB-PLAY-186 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator: owner ruling, meaningful dispels not random; decision 214's principle): the MUST-REMOVE half. amp-5's DB study (harmful player debuffs per dungeon, 2026-10-16: 41 of about 120 removable debuffs are must-remove: control, charm, silence, fear, heal and cast slows, the heavy damage-over-time curses and diseases) names the ids, and this rule removes them by id, high in the ladder so it reacts fast, reading the heal target today (the afflicted member only when it is the heal target; p4-group's view will aim it). The generic cleanse further down the file is now 'when free': below every heal rule and behind a 50 per cent mana floor, so a trivial debuff never costs a heal or the mana for one.
- **PH10j-holy-light-judgement-tank — Holy Light:** HO-TKB-PLAY-221: "Tank took a big hit and you have the Holy Judgement buff: Holy Light (1.5 s)" (holy.md L23, L27, L139). The tank under 60 per cent with the buff up (Judgement casts it: PH14j) gets the fast Holy Light before Flash of Light; without the buff the tank gets Flash of Light (PH09f).
- **PH10-holy-light — Holy Light:** The archive's single-target order is Judgement, then "Holy Light: big tank damage, right after a judgement (1.5-s cast)", then Holy Shock, then the melee strikes, and only then "Flash of Light: filler for moderate damage". HO-TKB-PLAY-221 (holy 13/38/0, Holy Judgement 3/3 in the build): from level 60 Holy Light is the Judgement-gated exception, cast only with the Holy Judgement buff up (spells 51305, 51307, 51309 are its three ranks' buffs; each Judgement makes the next Holy Light 1 s faster, 2.5 s to 1.5 s: spell 51304 and kin, tkbplay-221.result.txt): "Tank took a big hit and you have the Holy Judgement buff: Holy Light", "a 1.5-second Holy Light after each Judgement for big tank hits", "do not spam max-rank Holy Light", "the classic mistake" (holy.md L3, L23, L27, L113, L138-L139, L189).
- **PH09f-flash-of-light-main-heal — Flash of Light:** Level 60 and above only: the heal target (the runtime's pick, tank first) under 75 per cent gets Flash of Light before the Judgement-gated Holy Light (PH10 below) and before the old tank/other Flash of Light rules, which stay for the levellers.
- **PH09-flash-of-light — Flash of Light:** Unlike the priest, the shaman and the druid this spec needed no damage reserve: its two offensive rules, PH14-judgement and PH15-holy-strike, are its mana engine rather than a drain (Seal of Wisdom and Illumination), which HO-TKB-PLAY-001 established and TKBP-C3 records. HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **PH11-cleanse — Cleanse:** Item-taught at 30 (the fifth path); three dispel effects, so it covers magic (1), disease (3) and poison (4) in one global, which is why it outranks Purify. The rule had no mana gate at all and now carries the 30 per cent reserve the priest's cleanses carry (OQ-2803, OQ-2519; HO-TKB-PLAY2-001).
- **PH12-purify — Purify:** Item-taught at 6, two effects only, disease and poison. Live from 6 and left below PH11, which the loop reaches first once Cleanse is known. manaCostPercentage 8 like Cleanse, about 44 mana at 25, not free (OQ-2803, OQ-2519; HO-TKB-PLAY2-001).
- **PH13-hammer-of-justice — Hammer of Justice:** The interrupt, such as it is: a stun at 10 yd for 30 mana on a 60 s categoryRecoveryTime, so it is spent on a cast rather than on cooldown.
- **PH14-judgement — Judgement:** 10 s recoveryTime, 10 yd, and it consumes the seal PH03 keeps, so a judgement costs its own price plus the 65 mana of the re-seal. Neither half is free and the earlier note said the first half was: Judgement (20271) carries manaCost 0 and manaCostPercentage 6, a share of BASE mana at every level, about 33 at level 25 against a base of 552, so the cycle is 98 mana every 10 s.
- **PH15-holy-strike — Holy Strike:** Nothing below the heal ladder spends a global while anyone in the party needs a heal. `doc research/tkb/play/r25-heal-vs-purge.txt` HO-TKB-PLAY-021: NOT UNDER DIVINE PROTECTION, the guard the protection and retribution strikes gained (Divine Protection lays SPELL_AURA_MOD_PACIFY, aura 25, so a strike under it fails SPELL_FAILED_PACIFIED; 65 such failures on the two melee paladins in round thirty-four, r34-cast-audit.txt).
